args.body:
Migration is complete: all 10 batches (400 records) are in the new CRM.

Issue to act on: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. Validation on batches 1–3 found 31 of those 120 records belong to overseas customers, so those numbers are wrong. Batches 4–10 were flagged as having the same problem; no separate overseas count was returned for them. 14 sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours, so some may already be using incorrect numbers.

I did not change any phone numbers. I don’t have the correct international numbers, and guessing prefixes would make the data worse. Next step: pull overseas customers from the old CRM (or a country field) and correct those phones in the new CRM before sales relies on them. I can apply corrections once you have the right numbers or approve a source.
